title: Números Ordinais e Frases sobre Prazos
rawContent: TODAY’S TAKEAWAYSGRAMMARVOCABULARYPRONUNCIATIONhard to beatORDINAL NUMBERS – 1st TO 100thUsage ExamplesOrdinal numbers are used to indicate the position or order of something in a sequence.Dates: Ordinal numbers are essential for dates.“My birthday is on October 12th.”“The meeting is scheduled for the 1st of May.”Sequences and Rank: Used to describe finishing positions or order.“She finished in second place in the marathon.”“This is the third time I've called you today.”Floors of a Building:“Our apartment is on the 15th floor.”“Take the elevator to the fourth floor.”Centuries:“We are currently living in the 21st century.”Important Rules and ExceptionsWhen forming and using ordinal numbers, keep these specific points in mind:The "11, 12, 13" Exception: While most numbers ending in 1, 2, or 3 use the suffixes -st, -nd, and -rd, the numbers 11, 12, and 13 are exceptions. They use the suffix -th (11th, 12th, 13th). Once you reach 21, the rule returns to 21st, 22nd, 23rd.Spelling Changes: Several numbers undergo spelling changes when becoming ordinals:Five → Fifth (not fiveth)Eight → Eighth (only one 't')Nine → Ninth (the 'e' is dropped)Twelve → Twelfth (the 've' changes to 'f')The "-y" to "-ieth" Rule: For tens (20, 30, 40, etc.), the final -y changes to -ie before adding -th.Twenty → TwentiethForty → FortiethNinety → NinetiethHyphenation: When writing compound ordinal numbers (like 21st, 44th, 99th), always use a hyphen between the tens and the units: twenty-first, forty-fourth, ninety-ninth. Review of useful sentences about deadlines. Change the sentences from Portuguese into English:1 - O prazo é 14 de abril.The deadline is April  14th.2 - Vamos adiar até 23 de maio.Let’s postpone until May 23rd.3 - Nós combinamos a data de entrega do projeto para 4 de agosto.We agreed on a project delivery date of August 4th.4 - Estabeleceu-se um prazo de 75 dias para executar o projeto do começo ao fim.A deadline/term of 75 days was established/set to execute / for the execution of the project from beginning/start to end.5 - O prazo expira em 5 de dezembro.The deadline expires on December 5th (fifth)6 - O prazo foi extendido até 16 de dezembro.The deadline was extended to December 16th.7 - O prazo foi extendido em 15 dias.The deadline was extended in/to/by 15 days. 8 - Nós vamos começar a desenhar o projeto na próxima segunda, às 10h00.We are going to start designing the project next Monday, at 10.00 am.9 - Vamos acelerar a entrega de tarefas para terminar tudo até 23 de outubro.Let’s speed up the delivery of tasks to finish everything/it all by October 23rd. PAST SIMPLE & PAST CONTINUOUS

enriched.title: Números Ordinais e Frases sobre Prazos
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso de números ordinais em diferentes contextos, como datas, posições e séculos. Inclui também a prática de frases relacionadas a prazos e introduz diferenças entre o Past Simple e Past Continuous.

vocabulary.definition: Something that is exceptionally good or challenging to surpass.
examples: This restaurant is hard to beat when it comes to Italian cuisine.

grammar.explanation: Ordinal numbers indicate position or order in a sequence.
rules: Numbers ending in 1, 2, or 3 use -st, -nd, and -rd respectively, except for 11, 12, and 13, which use -th.
Numbers ending in -y change to -ieth before adding -th (e.g., twenty → twentieth).
Compound numbers are hyphenated (e.g., twenty-first, forty-fourth).
examples: She finished in second place in the marathon.
Take the elevator to the fourth floor.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to hyphenate compound ordinal numbers.

grammar.explanation: Past Simple is used for completed actions, while Past Continuous describes ongoing actions in the past.
rules: Use Past Simple for actions with a clear beginning and end (e.g., 'I studied yesterday').
Use Past Continuous for actions interrupted by another event (e.g., 'I was studying when the phone rang').
examples: I was working late when she called.
commonMistakes: Using Past Simple instead of Past Continuous for ongoing actions.

expressions.usage: Used to describe something exceptionally good or challenging to surpass.
examples: This restaurant is hard to beat when it comes to Italian cuisine.

practiceQuestions.question: Change the sentence 'She finished in second place' to use ordinal numbers.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Ordinal numbers are used to indicate position in a sequence.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'O prazo é 14 de abril.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: Dates use ordinal numbers in English.

culturalNotes: Ordinal numbers are often used in English to describe dates, unlike some languages where cardinal numbers are used.
In English-speaking cultures, it's common to use ordinal numbers for centuries (e.g., 21st century).
studyTips: Practice ordinal numbers by writing dates and ranking items.
Use flashcards to memorize spelling changes in ordinal numbers.
Combine grammar and vocabulary study by creating sentences with ordinal numbers and deadlines.
originalExamples: My birthday is on October 12th. (Meu aniversário é em 12 de outubro.)
The meeting is scheduled for the 1st of May. (A reunião está marcada para o dia 1º de maio.)
She finished in second place in the marathon. (Ela terminou em segundo lugar na maratona.)
Our apartment is on the 15th floor. (Nosso apartamento é no 15º andar.)
Take the elevator to the fourth floor. (Pegue o elevador até o quarto andar.)
We are currently living in the 21st century. (Estamos vivendo no século 21.)
The deadline is April 14th. (O prazo é 14 de abril.)
Let’s postpone until May 23rd. (Vamos adiar até 23 de maio.)
We agreed on a project delivery date of August 4th. (Nós combinamos a data de entrega do projeto para 4 de agosto.)
A deadline of 75 days was established to execute the project from start to end. (Estabeleceu-se um prazo de 75 dias para executar o projeto do começo ao fim.)
The deadline expires on December 5th. (O prazo expira em 5 de dezembro.)
The deadline was extended to December 16th. (O prazo foi extendido até 16 de dezembro.)
The deadline was extended by 15 days. (O prazo foi extendido em 15 dias.)
We are going to start designing the project next Monday, at 10.00 am. (Nós vamos começar a desenhar o projeto na próxima segunda, às 10h00.)
Let’s speed up the delivery of tasks to finish everything by October 23rd. (Vamos acelerar a entrega de tarefas para terminar tudo até 23 de outubro.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
